title: Extending an apps/alerting kind requires 3 coordinated edits
answers: What do I need to change when adding a field to AlertRule spec?
What must I update when adding a new kind to apps/alerting/rules?
What breaks if I forget to update compat.go after a schema change?
body:
1) CUE schema (e.g. apps/alerting/rules/kinds/v0alpha1/alertRule_spec.cue) must be regenerated (make gen-cue/gen-apps) to update generated Go/TS types; new/changed fields also typically need semantic checks added in the kind's validator.go and defaulting in mutator.go, since OpenAPI-generated validation (apps/alerting/rules/pkg/app/validation/builder.go's WithOpenAPIValidation) only checks shape.
2) Because AlertRule/RecordingRule dual-write to legacy SQL, spec/status field changes need matching updates in pkg/registry/apps/alerting/rules/alertrule/compat.go (both convertToK8sResource and convertToBaseDomainModel) or data is dropped on one side of the round trip.
3) A brand-new kind must be added to kinds: [...] in apps/alerting/rules/kinds/manifest.cue, given a case in buildKindValidator/buildKindMutator in apps/alerting/rules/pkg/app/app.go, and given switch cases in the AppInstaller in pkg/registry/apps/alerting/rules/register.go (GetLegacyStorage, GetStorageOptions, GetAuthorizer) — a missing GetLegacyStorage case panics at runtime rather than failing silently.
applies: Applies to rules/ and notifications/ sub-apps (kind-per-GVR pattern with legacy dual-write). Does not apply to alertrulequality/alertenrichment, which only have generated API types and no pkg/app or registry wiring yet.
